;Business and economy
*The [[Nikkei 225|Nikkei]] [[stock market index|index]] at the [[Tokyo Stock Exchange]] drops 5% to below 20,000, its lowest level since September 2017. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-12-25/nikkei-225-falls-below-20-000-as-japanese-stock-rout-accelerates (Bloomberg)] 

;International relations 
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]]
**[[North Korea]] and [[South Korea]] hold a ceremony for a project to reconnect rail and road links, although construction cannot start while sanctions over [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction|North Korea’s nuclear and missile programs]] remain in place. [http://gulftoday.ae/portal/e02c68cf-9ef2-4771-8680-03cf09c9b3da.aspx (''Gulf Today'')] [https://amp.sunherald.com/news/business/article223555755.html (''Sun Herald'')]

;Law and crime
*A man stabs a local government official and a police officer to death in the streets of [[Longyan]], [[China]], then hijacks a bus and drove it into pedestrians, killing eight people and wounding 22 others. Authorities said the perpetrator "took revenge on society" after a dispute with local officials about his father's veteran benefits. [https://edition-m.cnn.com/2018/12/25/asia/china-hijacked-bus-intl/index.html?r=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.google.com%2F (CNN)]
*[[Cannabis in Thailand]]
**[[Thailand]] approves marijuana for medical use and research. The country voted to amend the Narcotic Act of 1979 prior to the [[New Year's Day|New Year’s]] holiday. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-46679098 (BBC)] [https://www.cnbc.com/2018/12/25/thailand-approves-medical-marijuana-in-new-years-gift.html (CNBC)]
